title: Tabaxkat bu dëgër biy tabax mucc
intro: Nit ku am dal gu mat sëkk ak ngëm gu dëgër, nit ki def ay at yu bari ci liggéeyu boroom bi, di jànkoonte ak xeex ak bañ budul jeex. Seen jaar-jaar seede la bu am solo ci ngëm ci kanamu ñàkka gëm bu metti, mu dem ba mujjee nekk xew-xew bu am solo bu soppi melokaanu àdduna bi.
clues: Maa ngi def sama dundu lu yàgg di woo sama askan jaamu Yàlla.
Sama askan ñaawal nama, jiiñ ma njuumte bu leer ak dof.
Dañu ma sant ma tabax lu nuru lu jaxasoo ak sama dëkk bi tëju ci géej gi.
Ñu néew ñoo ko gëm ba noppi ànd ak man ak sama waa kër ci tabax bu amul fenn bii.
Maa ngi yóbbu ci gaal gi mbindéef bu nekk ñaar-ñaar, ni ko Yàlla digale.
Mbënd mu mag dafa laxasu ci kaw suuf si, muccal ñi ànd ak man ci sama gaal, waaye sama doom daa ñàkk ci gëmam.

outcome.label: Njureef
options: Nit ñi dañu féey ci ndox mi
Dënd ak melax dafa dóor askanam
outcome.answer: Nit ñi dañu féey ci ndox mi

arabic: مِّمَّا خَطِيٓـَٔـٰتِهِمْ أُغْرِقُوا۟ فَأُدْخِلُوا۟ نَارًۭا فَلَمْ يَجِدُوا۟ لَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَنصَارًۭا
verse: Because of their sins they were drowned and put into the Fire, and they found not for themselves besides Allāh [any] helpers. (71:25)
